facts.fact: The National Registration (Amendment) Regulations, 2026 were made on 23 July 2026 by the Homeland Security Minister under powers in the National Registration Act, which the NRB runs for National ID; the report gives the Act's number and year nowhere, and the instrument is an Act of parliament with regulations made under it.

systems.tiers: mobile money, SIM card, bank account and utility services use e-KYC verification

note: No cover fact: the regulations change fees, including for e-KYC verification, and the document states no rule that banks or phone companies must check identity against the system, nor that the Act sets up a biometric register or unique number.

slug: 2026-07-13 Malawi outlines plans to transition to digital IDs - CAJ News Africa

facts.fact: CAJ News reports a stakeholders' consultative meeting, just concluded, to review the existing National Registration Act (an Act of parliament, number and year not given) under the Digital Malawi Acceleration Project, as the registration bureau reviews registration laws; the document gives no date for the meeting, so the published date is used.

note: No cover fact: the article states plans for digital ID cards and a law review, not that the law in force provides for a digital identity or that rules were made under it.

facts.fact: The Principal Secretary says the National Registration Act of 2010 mandates the NRB to run the national registration and identification system.
The deck says the National Registration Act No. 13 of 2010 was enacted as the legal foundation for the national digital identity system, and the Bureau was established under it.
